design.purpose: Heat-proof table mat for hot dishes for family table: 26 sts green and blue stripes

steps.c: Set green and blue yarn and hook on table
Ch 27, 5 rows hdc in green, 26 sts
Work 3 more rows hdc in green
Work 5 rows hdc in blue, 26 sts
Work 5 rows hdc in green, 26 sts
Cut last tail and weave green tails
Weave in blue tails and trim
